android.desc: Binaural beats and brainwaves for sleep, focus, and calm, plus isochronic tones, ambient sounds, Solfeggio frequencies, and guided breathwork. Over 500,000 downloads and 14,000+ reviews at 4.6 stars. What this is A full sound library for sleep, focus, and a quieter head, with the freedom to build your own. You get over 100 ready-made binaural beats, dozens of ambient sounds that run from rain to brown noise, guided breathwork, and a set of Solfeggio frequencies. Layer a beat under a few sounds, each at its own volume, until a room sounds the way you want, then save it as your own mix. It plays in the background and offline, so it fits a real night and a real desk. No play button to hunt for. Tap a sound and it starts. What binaural beats actually are They are simply two slightly different tones playing one per ear, and your brain hears a third beat, the difference between them. Hold that difference steady and your brainwaves tend to settle into it. A steady sound in a noisy room makes sudden noises stop standing out. A steady pulse can do the same inside your head, giving a busy mind one even thing to follow. Because each ear must hear a different tone, binaural beats need headphones. We make no claims beyond that. For sleep, focus, and meditation A silent room is rarely silent. The door, the passing car, the voice down the hall, each one loud against nothing. The same intrusion that wakes you up also breaks a focus block and pulls you out of meditation. Lay a steady sound underneath and those edges disappear. For sleep, choose a Delta or Theta brainwave beat, layer in brown noise or rain, and set the fade-out timer so it drifts off as you do. For focus or meditation, hold that steady layer as long as you like. No headphones? Use an ambient sound or an isochronic track through any speaker. No headphones? Use isochronic tones Binaural beats need two ears. Isochronic tones do not. They pulse a single tone on and off, so they work through any speaker. The sound library, and your own creations Over 100 ready-made binaural beats, plus dozens of ambient and nature sounds: rain, ocean, fire, thunder, wind, and brown noise, pink noise, and white noise. Layer any of them under a beat, or under a meditation or breathwork practice you keep. You can also build unlimited custom brainwave beats, stack them into mixes, and chain them into your own brainwave playlists, say 20 minutes of Theta into 40 of Delta at night
